content.text:
Zero console errors. The page loaded and navigated to the Dashboard on its own.

All 6 previously-501 endpoints are now live:

| Endpoint | Status |
|---|---|
| `GET /api/adapters` | `[]` (no adapter registry in CF) |
| `GET /api/plugins/ui-contributions` | `[]` (no plugin registry in CF) |
| `GET /api/companies/:id/skills` | Direct DB query, proper source info |
| `GET /api/companies/:id/join-requests` | Direct DB query with dedup + invite enrichment |
| `GET /api/companies/:id/user-directory` | Direct DB query |
| `GET /api/companies/:id/events/ws` | CF-native WebSocket (101 Switching Protocols) |

The implementation lives in [cf-extra-routes.ts](packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/worker/cf-extra-routes.ts), registered in [app.ts](packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/worker/app.ts) before the `/api/*` catch-all. The WebSocket connection stays open but emits no events — once you wire up a Durable Object pub/sub bus, it can be plumbed through that same endpoint.
